kind: A screen at full size, one seed: each arm against the plain stack at its best pilot rate. It chooses which cell forms join the next full-size design; it decides nothing about them by itself.
why: After the lifted-ceiling pilot, the stack's full-size gap at each model's best rate is 0.036, and it is knowledge: new contexts carry it (full_size_rate_pilot.json, full_size_lifted_ceiling_pilot.json). The largest step that v15's walk from the Transformer to the stack priced was the unit: plain rectifying units in place of gated ones, +0.0253 at full size (docs/STREAM_FORM.md). The stack's threshold cells are plain units. Three spike-only forms of a better unit exist: a gate dendrite that lets in a share of what a value dendrite collects (a gated unit), a cell that gates itself (a square near silence), and noisy thresholds (a cell smooth on average, learning from the true slope of its average count). The test bed screens them by their slope over data (gated_cells_with_data.json, noisy_thresholds_with_data.json), but results about knowledge on the test bed have not always carried to full size (docs/ROADMAP.md, rule 6). This screen measures them where the gap is, in one 24,000-update run each at the plain stack's best rate.

arms.fs-gate6: --granule-gate 4 --granule-shunt --granule-cells 712: 712 gated cells a level, 34,783,136 parameters (27,764 fewer than the base)
arms.fs-self6: --granule-gate 4 --granule-self-gate --granule-shunt: 1,188 self-gated cells a level, 34,810,900 parameters as the base
arms.fs-noise6: --cell-noise 0.5: noisy thresholds, 34,810,900 parameters as the base

base: fs-st6 of full_size_rate_pilot: the same recipe and seed, 1.31985 on the first 2,000,000 validation bytes as streams
training: full.sh KIND stack (v16's stack with forgetting slopes, windows of 512 bytes, batch 8, 24,000 updates, warmup 1,000, cosine over the run, seed 20001) at peak rate 6e-4, the plain pool (the pilot's decision), server GPU 1; code v17m (5d1c665), which is v17l with the --cell-noise option added, off in fs-gate6 and fs-self6 and then the same computation as v17l
measure: as full_size_rate_pilot: the first 2,000,000 validation bytes as 16 unbroken streams after 8,192 unscored lead bytes, averaged weights, bits kept; each arm paired with fs-st6 by experiments/gap_by_piece.py (near 496, far 8,192); the pulses a byte and the share of entries at the membrane bound (experiments/membrane_saturation.py)
reading: An arm earns a place in the next full-size design if it scores at least 0.010 below fs-st6 and its gain on new contexts has an interval above zero. An arm between 0.005 and 0.010 below fs-st6 earns a second seed before that. Otherwise it is reported only. Recorded either way: every score, the gains by context, the pulses a byte and the saturation.
schedule: Three jobs pinned to GPU 1 at priority 3: after the full-size word-heads run frees GPU 1 this night, behind the full-size pair's arms (priorities 1 and 2) in later windows; paused and resumed across windows like every job.
seen_before_recording: fs-st6 1.31985 and the rest of full_size_rate_pilot; full_size_lifted_ceiling_pilot (lifted 1.31341 and 1.31255); CPU checks of 4 updates at full size for each arm (finite; the parameters above). The test bed's screens of these forms have not trained.
